install_cmds: python -c "import torch, transformers; from transformers import AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, AutoTokenizer; print('transformers', transformers.__version__, 'torch', torch.__version__)"

data_deps.name: text_simplification_model
data_deps.description: Three revision-pinned frozen checkpoints are staged offline: mrm8488/t5-small-finetuned-turk-text-simplification, mrm8488/t5-small-finetuned-text-simplification, and mrm8488/t5-base-finetuned-turk-text-simplification. The capacity task requires all three; every other sibling uses the base Turk model. Canonical config, tokenizer, architecture, byte size, and weight SHA-256 values are verified by common.py before inference. The complete 359/359/720 source partitions are intentionally agent-visible under vendor/text-simplification/_simp_data; held-out human references remain verifier-only under each tasks/simp-*/data directory.
